notes: Play-test revision: black-eyed-pea weather, repeatable plant growth, 3-Water cap, face-up organism-card Compost, no Nutrients, and 20-point scoring. Original prototype wording retained under source/. No import-time shortening.

cards.mechanic_1: Grow: Spend 1 Light + 1 Water for +1 Population. Repeat while able, up to the maximum.
cards.mechanic_2: Host Plant: Monarch caterpillars feed only on Milkweed. Monarch +1 Population; Milkweed -1 Population.
cards.extra_info: Pollinators: Monarch, Carpenter Bee. Herbivores: Monarch, Aphids.

cards.mechanic_1: Grow: Spend 1 Light + 1 Water for +1 Population. Repeat while able, up to the maximum.
cards.mechanic_2: Drought Tolerant: On a Hot day, Frogfruit keeps its stored Water instead of losing 1.
cards.extra_info: Pollinators: Monarch Butterfly and Eastern Carpenter Bee.

cards.mechanic_1: Grow: Spend 1 Light + 1 Water for +1 Population. Repeat while able, up to the maximum.
cards.mechanic_2: Pollination: A Monarch or Carpenter Bee may visit. Both pollinator and plant gain +1 Population.
cards.extra_info: Aphids may feed here: Aphids +1 Population; plant -1 Population.

cards.mechanic_1: Grow: Spend 1 Light + 1 Water for +1 Population. Repeat while able, up to the maximum.
cards.mechanic_2: Pollination: A Carpenter Bee may visit. Both bee and plant gain +1 Population.
cards.extra_info: Aphids may feed here: Aphids +1 Population; plant -1 Population.

cards.mechanic_1: Grow: Spend 1 Light + 1 Water for +1 Population. Repeat while able, up to the maximum.
cards.mechanic_2: Large Plant: Sunflower may hold up to 4 Population instead of the usual 3.
cards.extra_info: Pollinators: Monarch, Carpenter Bee. Herbivore: Aphids.

cards.mechanic_1: Pollinate: Visit Milkweed, Frogfruit, Mistflower, or Sunflower. Monarch and plant each gain +1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Caterpillar Feeding: Feed on Milkweed. Monarch +1 Population; Milkweed -1 Population.
cards.extra_info: Choose one action per activation.

cards.mechanic_1: Generalist Pollinator: Visit any flowering plant in the garden. Bee and plant each gain +1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Population Limit: Neither the bee nor its plant partner may gain Population above its maximum.
cards.extra_info: Activate once per round. Play only if a flowering plant is present.

cards.mechanic_1: Feed: Use Milkweed, Mistflower, Bluebonnet, or Sunflower. Aphids +1 Population; plant -1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Honeydew Mutualism: When these Aphids feed successfully, Fire Ants in the same plot also gain +1 Population.
cards.extra_info: Those ants block Assassin Bugs and Parasitoid Wasps, but not Anoles or Wrens.

cards.mechanic_1: Hunt: Take Aphids, Monarchs, Carpenter Bees, or Parasitoid Wasps anywhere. Assassin Bug +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Ant Protection: Cannot hunt Aphids protected by Red Imported Fire Ants.
cards.extra_info: At 0 Population, prey enters Compost face up. Activate once per round.

cards.mechanic_1: Parasitize: Hunt Aphids anywhere in the garden. Wasp +1 Population; Aphids -1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Specialist: Cannot hunt other organisms or Aphids protected by Red Imported Fire Ants.
cards.extra_info: At 0 Population, prey enters Compost face up. Activate once per round.

cards.mechanic_1: Honeydew Mutualism: Protect Aphids in your plot. Each time those Aphids feed successfully, Fire Ants gain +1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Hunt: Take Monarchs, Carpenter Bees, Assassin Bugs, or Parasitoid Wasps. Fire Ants +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
cards.extra_info: Ants stop Assassin Bugs and Parasitoid Wasps from hunting protected Aphids.

cards.mechanic_1: Hunt: Take any insect anywhere in the garden. Anole +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Ignore Ant Protection: Brown Anoles may hunt Aphids even when Fire Ants protect them.
cards.extra_info: At 0 Population, prey enters Compost face up. Activate once per round.

cards.mechanic_1: Hunt: Take any insect or Brown Anole anywhere. Wren +1 Population; prey -1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Ignore Ant Protection: Carolina Wrens may hunt Aphids even when Fire Ants protect them.
cards.extra_info: At 0 Population, prey enters Compost face up. Activate once per round.

cards.mechanic_1: Decompose: Turn 1 face-up organism in Compost face down on bottom. Give one of your plants +1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Always Playable: A decomposer may enter your plot even when no food or prey is present.
cards.extra_info: Enter with 1 Population; maximum 3. Activate once per round.

cards.mechanic_1: Decompose: Turn 1 face-up organism in Compost face down on bottom. Give one of your plants +1 Population.
cards.mechanic_2: Rapid Recycling: Instead, decompose 2 face-up cards in one activation. Give +1 Population to a plant for each.
cards.extra_info: The illustration is a conceptual microscope view, not a photograph.

cards.mechanic_1: Give every plant +1 Water, up to its 3-Water cap. Return any excess to the supply.
cards.mechanic_2: Play instead of an organism. Resolve, then put this effect face down on Compost's bottom.
cards.extra_info: Effect cards never score points.

cards.mechanic_1: Remove 1 Water from every plant that has any. Return lost Water to the supply.
cards.mechanic_2: Play instead of an organism. Resolve, then put this effect face down on Compost's bottom.
cards.extra_info: Effect cards never score points.

cards.mechanic_1: Remove 1 Water from every plant that has any. Then one of your plants with Water left gains +1 Population, up to its maximum.
cards.mechanic_2: Play instead of an organism. Resolve, then put this effect face down on Compost's bottom.
cards.extra_info: Effect cards never score points.

cards.mechanic_1: Discard 1 organism card from your hand face up onto Compost. It can be decomposed once.
cards.mechanic_2: Play only with an organism in hand. Put this effect face down on Compost's bottom.
cards.extra_info: Face-up organism cards are the only decomposable Compost.

cards.mechanic_1: Choose one of your plants. Hot-day evaporation does not remove Water from it until your next turn.
cards.mechanic_2: Keep Mulch under that plant until your next turn, then put it face down on Compost's bottom.
cards.extra_info: Effect cards never score points.

cards.mechanic_1: Choose one plant you control (any demo Plant). It gains +1 Population, up to its maximum.
cards.mechanic_2: Play instead of an organism. Resolve, then put this effect face down on Compost's bottom.
cards.extra_info: Effect cards never score points.

cards.mechanic_1: Choose one Garden Plot. Every insect there loses 1 Population. Return lost counters to the supply.
cards.mechanic_2: Play instead of an organism. Resolve, then put this effect face down on Compost's bottom.
cards.extra_info: At 0 Population, organism cards enter Compost face up.
